label: StudyEVNEED item 3, TIMING HALF ONLY. GPU-seconds saved by sending RECENT instead of full history, and infeasible questions rescued, on the 10/12/14 crossover band.
caveat: EVERY ROW IS PRE-PRESSURE: gpu_kv_tokens was handed to arms and never enforced and there was no automatic eviction. The accuracy half is NOT computed: 0 of 845 StudyR1 questions exceed the 19,381-token breakeven, so the rescued questions have NO committed accuracy measurement. That is an EVIDENCE GAP, not an analysis limitation.
construction: history_tokens AT QUESTION ARRIVAL, as in the D132 ceiling, never the session final size
headline: 95.6 to 95.8 percent of recall GPU time saved; 28 of 28 infeasible questions rescued. At 14 devices recall rebuilds cost 385.5 GPU-s over a 600 s run, about 64 percent of one GPU, and RECENT would cut that to 2.7 percent.
